record.question: How many teams are there in the newly introduced Hero Indian Super League?
record.explanation: The league's dated August 2014 launch release explicitly says FC Goa was one of eight teams in the inaugural 2014 season. Anchor newly introduced to the January 2015 exam. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.indiansuperleague.com/press-releases/goan-football-scores-with-the-launch-of-home-team-fc-goa Independently checked solution, unofficial.
